description: Text an owner from the user's default approved number (or Spur's workspace number if they have none; see spur_get_texting_setup). Show the user the exact message and recipient and get approval before calling with confirm=true. Billed per 160-character segment (70 if it has emoji or special characters), so a 200-character text costs 2.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user explicitly approved this exact action in the conversation. Never assume approval.

message.description: Exact SMS text the user approved

owner_id.description: Owner id (UUID from a Spur list/search tool)

name: spur_send_sms
title: Send SMS
